description: Welcome to Divine Light Vibes, where we align with the universal energies to manifest abundance, peace, and healing. Our content brings you closer to the cosmic consciousness and guides you on the journey of self-discovery and growth.
is_official_reasoning: Not official. The official Bashar channel is 'Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka' (youtube.com/BasharChanneledbyDarrylAnka, run by Bashar Communications). Divine Light Vibes: (1) uses a generic 'manifest abundance' description with no mention of Bashar Communications, Darryl Anka or bashar.org; (2) lists a dmca.jp contact address, a pattern typical of re-upload/clip channels; (3) its channel keywords include 'bashar clips'; (4) all videos found carry the clickbait prefix 'Bashar Twin Flame -- ...' and, where a transcript was checked (nyj_SuIkL0c), ran ~2,100 words (a 12-15 minute clip cut from a longer public session), not a full session; (5) its favorites playlist (FLugr4dreXep1lI_6JIDhU8g) is titled 'Bashar Channeling Playlist 2026' with 326 videos, consistent with an aggregator/clip channel.
video_count_notes: Subscriber and upload counts were not visible via WebFetch (YouTube channel /videos, /streams, /playlists and /about pages returned only channel metadata, no video grid; the RSS feed is blocked by robots.txt; watch pages returned HTTP 429). The channel's favorites playlist 'Bashar Channeling Playlist 2026' (list=FLugr4dreXep1lI_6JIDhU8g) reports 326 videos, which suggests the channel has on the order of a few hundred uploads, but this is an inference, not a confirmed upload count.
content_pattern: Every discovered upload is titled 'Bashar Twin Flame -- <sensational subtitle> ( Darryl Anka )'. Transcript check of one video showed a genuine Bashar/Darryl Anka session excerpt (live audience, hang-drum interlude, star-naming exercise), i.e. re-cut excerpts of real sessions, not AI narration. No full-length session uploads from this channel were found.

notes: Video list above was assembled from WebSearch results (allowed_domains youtube.com) and is NOT a complete listing of the channel's uploads: YouTube channel tab pages did not expose the video grid to WebFetch. Attribution of 'Bashar Twin Flame --' titles to this channel is based on (a) direct transcript-page confirmation for nyj_SuIkL0c and (b) the same title pattern appearing in the 'Divine Light Vibes Bashar' search results; individual non-verified items could belong to a sister channel with the same naming scheme. Upload dates were not obtainable. The channel is relevant to the corpus only as a source of short clips; it does not appear to host full-length sessions. Other channels that DO upload full-length sessions (found during this strand): 'Divine Insights' (@Divine_Insights_Official, UCKy61LU_IToA4CJBggQQvYg, description: 'Gateway to spiritual wisdom inspired by Bashar teachings'), 'Hibbs Teachings Hub', 'ozy bourne', 'Suthisa Sonphlaeng', 'Heart Coherence Collaborative' (playlist of 6 full sessions), and the official 'Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka' channel which posts 'Upcoming Event!' promos and 'Highlights', not full sessions.
related_findings_reupload_ecosystem: Transcript comparison across 27 digests shows the full-session re-upload channels (Divine Insights, Eternal Inspiration, my daily life, ozy bourne, Suthisa Sonphlaeng, Hibbs Teachings Hub) frequently (a) relabel one session under several invented titles/dates (e.g. one circa-2016 session appears as 'Breaking News - Sep 21 2025', 'Breaking News - May 26 2026' and 'Breaking News - Mar 15 2026'; the Aug 23 2025 'Signs of the Times' livestream appears as 'A Step Along The Way - May 30 2026' and 'The Precursors - Jun 6 2026'), and (b) stamp 2025/2026 dates on sessions whose content dates them to 2016 (Cybo, The Story Tree, Levels of Mastery). Title dates from these channels must not be trusted without checking transcript-internal evidence; official session titles/dates come from the 'Bashar :: Upcoming Event!' promos on the official channel.
